boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Named campus spaces for studying, meeting, recreation, reflection, and student-led arts, documented by St. Catherine University.

cards.title: Coeur de Catherine
cards.subtitle: Campus student center
cards.notes: Start at the Information Center for directions or checkout items, then use this central building to connect with campus services and other students.
cards.short_summary: The campus hub combines student services, dining, library access, and activity spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Catherine University identifies Coeur de Catherine as its campus student center and says it houses student services, dining, the library, and more.
cards.access_notes: Located on campus; individual services and spaces may have separate hours or access rules.

cards.title: The Pulse and Game Room
cards.subtitle: Coeur de Catherine
cards.notes: Bring a class project to a booth, watch TV, or check out game supplies from the Information Center with a valid student ID.
cards.short_summary: A student-programming venue paired with a connected game room.
cards.evidence_claim: The university says The Pulse supports gathering, class projects, TV viewing, and student programming; its connected game room has supplies checked out through the Information Center.
cards.source_title: Coeur de Catherine | St. Catherine University
cards.access_notes: Game-room supply checkout requires a valid student ID; food purchases at The Pulse are optional.

cards.title: Student Organization Center
cards.subtitle: Coeur de Catherine
cards.notes: For a club project, reserve this space for a meeting, workshop, or presentation and use its shared organization resources as applicable.
cards.short_summary: A working base for student clubs, leadership groups, and their meetings.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Catherine University says the Student Organization Center is available to student clubs and organizations for meetings, workshops, presentations, and group business.
cards.source_title: Coeur de Catherine | St. Catherine University
cards.access_notes: Intended for student clubs and organizations; coordinate use through the relevant campus process.

cards.title: Dew Drop Lounge
cards.subtitle: Coeur de Catherine
cards.notes: Set up for a study session or a conversation with friends; coffee and grab-and-go items are available if you choose to buy something.
cards.short_summary: A lounge explicitly designated for studying and spending time with friends.
cards.evidence_claim: The university directs visitors to Dew Drop Lounge to study, spend time with friends, and access coffee and grab-and-go items.
cards.source_title: Coeur de Catherine | St. Catherine University
cards.access_notes: Located in Coeur de Catherine; refreshments are optional purchases.

cards.title: St. Catherine University Library
cards.subtitle: First floor, Coeur de Catherine
cards.notes: Choose an independent or collaborative work session, use a computer, or ask a librarian for research help before settling into the collection.
cards.short_summary: A campus library built for study, collaboration, computers, and research support.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Catherine University says its library supports studying, independent and collaborative work, librarian consultations, and computer use.
cards.source_title: Coeur de Catherine | St. Catherine University
cards.access_notes: The library is on the first floor of Coeur de Catherine; check the library for current access and service hours.

cards.title: Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: St. Catherine University Library
cards.notes: Reserve a room online or at the tablets outside each room when your group needs a dedicated place to read, plan, or work together.
cards.short_summary: Reservable library rooms for focused group work.
cards.evidence_claim: The library states that its group study rooms can be reserved online or on tablets outside each room.
cards.source_title: Accessibility | St. Catherine University Library and Archives
cards.access_notes: Reservations are required or may be available; contact the Circulation Desk for booking assistance.

cards.title: Library Quiet Space
cards.subtitle: Lower level, St. Catherine University Library
cards.notes: Head to the lower level when you need individual quiet study; use the library’s other study rooms instead for conversation or group work.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet area for individual study within the library.
cards.evidence_claim: The library identifies a designated quiet space for individual study on its lower level.
cards.source_title: Accessibility | St. Catherine University Library and Archives
cards.access_notes: Located on the library’s lower level; follow posted library policies.

cards.title: Dew Drop Pond
cards.subtitle: St. Catherine University campus
cards.notes: Take a short outdoor reset by the pond, or use the nearby grounds as a meeting point before heading back to a campus activity.
cards.short_summary: A named outdoor campus oasis with a bridge and chapel backdrop.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Catherine University describes Dew Drop Pond as an outdoor oasis on campus.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor space; use established paths and observe any posted campus notices.

cards.title: English Garden
cards.subtitle: Near Whitby
cards.notes: Use this named garden near Whitby for a quiet pause between classes, and leave the plantings and shared setting undisturbed for others.
cards.short_summary: A campus garden identified by St. Kate’s spiritual-life leadership as a peaceful setting.
cards.evidence_claim: A St. Catherine University news article identifies the English Garden near Whitby as one of a campus leader’s places to find a moment of peace.
cards.source_title: Welcoming a new academic year, and a new president | St. Catherine University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor garden near Whitby; maintain quiet and respect landscaping.

cards.title: The Frey Theater
cards.subtitle: St. Catherine University campus
cards.notes: Look for student-led productions during the academic year and attend when a public performance is scheduled; ticketing or event rules can vary.
cards.short_summary: A 180-seat black-box theater used for student-led productions.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Catherine University describes The Frey Theater as a 180-seat black-box theater that hosts two student-led productions each year.
cards.access_notes: Access depends on scheduled performances and event policies; tickets may be required for some events.
